The '''Mahogany Dresser''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|7500}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

It can be used to store [[clothing]], [[hats]], [[footwear|shoes]], and [[rings]].
